adoption_gate: Promote a reranker only when held-out MRR or nDCG improves without reducing recall; any candidate above twice baseline p95 latency stays optional.
notes: Every candidate uses the same documents, cases, embedding model, hybrid candidates, top_k, and candidate_k.
Model initialization is warmed once and recorded separately from steady-state evaluation latency.
The no-reranker profile returns the first five hybrid fusion results from the same 24-candidate prefetch.
